warning: PREVIEW ONLY — not final seed data. Domain normalization required before SQL insert.

rows.criterion: Demonstrates basic catching and throwing competence
rows.threshold: Catches 7/10 underhand tosses from 3m; throws into 1m hoop 5/10 from 3m
rows.notes: Catching is foundational; if regressed across 2 sessions, work returns to multi-sport ABCs.

rows.criterion: Holds racquet correctly and contacts a stationary ball
rows.threshold: Recognizable grip + clean contact in 5/10 attempts
rows.notes: [PROPOSED:] If Swinget warm-up is integrated, log dominant body-organization observation here.

rows.criterion: Engages with peers in partner activities for full session block
rows.threshold: Sustained engagement 15 min × 3 sessions in a row
rows.notes: Disengagement is logged as a flag, not a fail; pattern matters more than a single instance.

rows.criterion: Listens through a 60-second instruction without disengaging
rows.threshold: 60s sustained attention × 3 separate session attempts

rows.criterion: Drop-hit rally with coach to a target zone (3+ shots)
rows.threshold: 3+ consecutive contacts to a target zone × 3 separate sessions

rows.criterion: Serves the ball over the modified net
rows.threshold: 5/10 stationary serves clear net into modified service box

rows.criterion: Knows the score in a simple rally game
rows.threshold: Player can state the current score on demand × 3 sessions

rows.criterion: Plays a full game-block (10–15 min) with sustained attention
rows.threshold: 10–15 min × 3 separate sessions

rows.criterion: Sustained mini-rally with peer (3+ shots in a row)
rows.threshold: 3+ consecutive shots × 3 sessions, with at least 2 different peers
rows.notes: Different peers requirement avoids same-partner accommodation effect.

rows.criterion: Plays a full mini-match using modified scoring without coach intervention
rows.threshold: 1 full mini-match end-to-end × 2 separate occasions

rows.criterion: Recognizable forehand and backhand swing shape on video review
rows.threshold: Forehand AND backhand both pass shape check on slow-mo video
rows.notes: [PROPOSED:] If Swing Check app is available at this stage as a basic recording tool, use it for the video; otherwise coach phone video.

rows.criterion: Demonstrates basic sportsmanship behaviors in match context
rows.threshold: All of: calls own lines, handshake at end, no equipment-throwing

rows.criterion: Reliable forehand and backhand under feed
rows.threshold: 7/10 land in court on each wing, fed from 3 feed positions
rows.recording_method: Coach tally during structured feed block

rows.criterion: Can rally crosscourt with a peer (5+ shots) on at least one wing
rows.threshold: 5+ consecutive crosscourt shots × 3 sessions

rows.criterion: Basic volley contact in a fed drill
rows.threshold: 5/10 fed volleys clear net and land in court

rows.criterion: Plays Orange-ball matches with modified scoring and completes them independently
rows.threshold: Completes 3+ Orange-ball matches without coach intervention
rows.notes: Outcome (W/L) not gated; completion is the criterion at this stage.

rows.criterion: Sustained rally with movement (5+ shots) with a peer
rows.threshold: 5+ shots with movement × 3 sessions, 2+ peers

rows.criterion: Serve and return start a point reliably
rows.threshold: 60%+ serve-in rate, 60%+ return-in rate on first attempts
rows.recording_method: Coach tally during structured serve+return block

rows.criterion: Recognizes and names middle vs crosscourt zones in live play
rows.threshold: Player can name the zone of incoming and outgoing balls in 8/10 shots, tested in fed scenario

rows.criterion: Bisector recovery is visible (not demanded) in coached rally drills
rows.threshold: Recovery toward middle observed in 3/5 rallies during a coached drill block
rows.notes: Visible = directional intent toward middle. Quality of execution comes at Orange 3 → Green 1.

rows.criterion: Wins matches at Orange ball at appropriate competitive event
rows.threshold: ≥30% match-win rate at age-appropriate Orange-ball events over 12 weeks
rows.notes: Match-win rate is over events the system flagged as 'appropriate level' per the Competition Track.

rows.criterion: Demonstrates one repeatable pattern (e.g., crosscourt forehand setup)
rows.threshold: Pattern executed in 3 of 5 rallies during coached pattern drill, × 3 sessions

rows.criterion: Independent in basic match etiquette and scoring
rows.threshold: All of: serves correct side, knows score, makes own line calls, manages changeover routine

rows.criterion: Bisector recovery is the default in drill
rows.threshold: Recovery toward bisector in 4/5 rallies during coached drill block

rows.criterion: Reliable groundstrokes from full-court positions
rows.threshold: 7/10 land deep (past service line) on feed from baseline, both wings
rows.recording_method: Coach tally during structured deep-ball drill

rows.criterion: Basic spin control on both wings (visible topspin)
rows.threshold: Topspin clearly visible (ball arc + bounce behavior) in 6/10 shots, both wings

rows.criterion: Approach-volley as a recognized unit
rows.threshold: Executes approach-then-volley sequence in 3 of 5 attempts during pattern drill

rows.criterion: Wins at least 30% of matches at Green-ball events over 12 weeks
rows.threshold: ≥30% W rate, age-appropriate Green-ball events

rows.criterion: Demonstrates one-to-one and two-to-one patterns in match play
rows.threshold: Each pattern observed in 2+ of 5 rallies during a match context, × 3 separate matches

rows.criterion: Recognizes short ball and acts on it
rows.threshold: Acts on short balls (moves forward, attacks) in 60%+ of opportunities, across coached drill and match
rows.recording_method: Coach tally during drill + match observation

rows.criterion: Bisector recovery is the default in match, not just drill
rows.threshold: Bisector recovery visible in 3/5 rallies during observed match

rows.criterion: Maintains ~50% win rate at age-appropriate Green-ball events
rows.threshold: 45–55% W rate (or higher) over 12-week window

rows.criterion: Wins ≥50% of matches at age-appropriate Green-ball events over 12 weeks
rows.threshold: ≥50% W rate at age-appropriate events

rows.criterion: Demonstrates a personal game style emerging
rows.threshold: Player can name preferred pattern AND execute it in 3 of 5 rallies during coached match context

rows.criterion: Serve and return are reliable point-starters
rows.threshold: First-serve in-rate ≥60%; return-of-serve in-rate ≥75%
rows.recording_method: Coach tally during match + post-match log

rows.criterion: Tactical decisions are intentional, not reactive
rows.threshold: Player can articulate tactical intent for 3+ key points after match, × 4 matches

rows.criterion: Comfortable rallying at standard pace (sustained 6+ shot rallies)
rows.threshold: 6+ shot rallies sustained in 4 of 10 sampled rallies during practice match

rows.criterion: All technical fundamentals reliable — no shot is a 'liability'
rows.threshold: All of: forehand, backhand, volley, serve, return, slice — none flagged as unreliable by coach assessment

rows.criterion: Competitive Yellow-ball matches with positive ratio at appropriate level
rows.threshold: ≥50% W rate at age-appropriate Yellow-ball events over 12 weeks

rows.criterion: Self-managed pre-match routine
rows.threshold: All of: equipment check, hydration, warm-up sequence, mental cue — executed without coach prompting × 4 matches

rows.criterion: Identifiable game style — player and coach can name it
rows.threshold: Player and coach independently name the same game style; style visible in 4 of 5 sampled matches

rows.criterion: Tactical maturity in pattern execution under pressure
rows.threshold: Executes 2+ patterns reliably (3+ of 5 attempts each) under pressure-point scenarios during practice matches

rows.criterion: Serve and return are weapons or reliable neutralizers
rows.threshold: First-serve points-won ≥55% AND return-points-won ≥35% at age-appropriate competitive level

rows.criterion: Physical preparation matches competitive demands — no fatigue-driven losses in third sets
rows.threshold: Coach + S&C review: no third-set physical breakdown in last 4 three-set matches

rows.criterion: Demonstrated ability to win at competitive sanctioned events at appropriate level
rows.threshold: ≥40% match-win rate at national-level events (or equivalent) over 24 weeks
rows.recording_method: Match record (auto-pulled from sanctioned tournament data)

rows.criterion: Psychologically and physically ready for year-round tennis-specific training
rows.threshold: All of: load tolerance demonstrated (no overuse flags last 12 weeks), school/life balance manageable, player + parent commitment confirmed

rows.criterion: Ownership of preparation — player drives the plan, coach approves
rows.threshold: Player initiates 3+ tactical or training adjustments per 4-week block with coach approval

rows.criterion: Personal game style is durable under fatigue and pressure
rows.threshold: Game style visible in 3rd-set scenarios in 3 of 4 observed three-setters

rows.criterion: Demonstrated competitive results at appropriate level
rows.threshold: ≥40% match-win rate at national; making rounds at international junior

rows.criterion: Physical preparation matches single-period demands — no fatigue-driven losses
rows.threshold: All of: ACR in safe range last 12 weeks, no overuse injuries, physical capacity tests at federation standard

rows.criterion: Tactical patterns reliable under fatigue (pattern fidelity holds in third sets)
rows.threshold: Pattern execution rate in 3rd sets within 10% of 1st-set rate, × 3 three-set matches

rows.criterion: Self-managed competitive plan with coach approval
rows.threshold: Player drafted next-block competitive plan; coach + director approved with ≤2 substantive edits

rows.criterion: Double-periodized year successfully managed
rows.threshold: All of: two clean competitive blocks completed, no major injuries, no overtraining flags, recovery markers in normal range
rows.notes: Once-a-year gate by definition; can be evaluated mid-year if 6 months of evidence available.

rows.criterion: Tournament travel autonomy demonstrated
rows.threshold: Player has self-managed 3+ tournament trips (logistics, recovery, preparation) in last 24 weeks

rows.criterion: Tactical adjustments executed mid-match in pressure scenarios
rows.threshold: Mid-match tactical adjustment observed and confirmed effective in 3+ pressure-point scenarios across last 6 matches

rows.criterion: Healthy 3:1 win-loss in primary competitive plan over 24-week window
rows.threshold: Win rate ≥75% in events designated as 'primary plan' (development-paced, not 'stretch' events)
rows.notes: Tennis Canada framing — 3:1 healthy ratio is in primary plan, not all events.

rows.criterion: Triple-periodized year managed successfully; tournament travel fully self-managed; performance-on-demand at major events; competitive at the next macro-level (ITF / college / professional, depending on pathway)
rows.threshold: All four conditions met over a 12-month review window
rows.notes: Transition out of academy curriculum, not a stage-up.
